page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 32 vCPUs and 32 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU operates at a base frequency of 2.0 GHz with a shared allocation model under the KVM hypervisor. The system features 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 12.0 GB of RAM per core. Graphics acceleration is delivered by three NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a combined 144 GB of VRAM.

Benchmark evaluations place this server in the top tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng, alongside top-tier Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores. Memory bandwidth tests show strong performance for both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block read and write operations. The system demonstrates top-tier capabilities in text and image processing, database operations, and Redis SET operations. For artificial intelligence workloads, LLM inference speeds for prompt processing and text generation using both small and medium models rank in the top tier.

A key architectural tradeoff is the absence of local storage, meaning external storage solutions must be utilized. Additionally, the CPU allocation is shared rather than dedicated. Despite these factors, the high density of GPU resources and system memory makes this server suitable for GPU-accelerated workloads, including medium-scale LLM inference, image processing, ray tracing, and complex database operations.
